researchMeta.scope: Judge-focused features (sole data entry person), Arabic RTL, Egyptian legal corpus

platforms.name: Harvey AI
keyFeatures: Case law research with grounded citations (no fabrication)
Harvey Mobile — on-the-go access for attorneys
platforms.judgeApplicability: Medium — drafting & research translate to judge's reasoning/draft fields, but Harvey is firm-billing-oriented. Side-by-side opinion comparison is the killer feature to port.

platforms.name: Lexis+ AI (with Protégé)
keyFeatures: Conversational search across authoritative LexisNexis corpus
Highlight & Annotate feature for marking key passages
Lexis Create — Word add-in for drafting in-flow
platforms.judgeApplicability: High — Protégé-style personalization, highlight/annotate, and Shepard's-like citation signals all map directly to a judge's research workflow.

platforms.name: Westlaw / Thomson Reuters CoCounsel
keyFeatures: West Key Number System — 100+ year classification taxonomy of legal concepts (topic & key number) for cross-jurisdictional research
Westlaw Edge — AI-enhanced research with verified answers
CoCounsel — agentic AI for deep research + litigation document analysis
Practical Law — practice notes, checklists, how-to guides
Brief analysis tool + judicial analytics (insights on judges)
platforms.judgeApplicability: High — Key Number classification taxonomy could inspire an Egyptian legal-issue taxonomy; KeyCite-like verification already partly implemented via our verify-citation route.

platforms.name: CaseMine (Indian AI legal research + Amicus generative AI)
keyFeatures: Cross-jurisdictional case law search (US, UK, India)
Amicus generative AI Q&A with cited authorities
Citation network visualization (which cases cite which)
AI-assisted reasoning extraction (how courts reasoned, not just what they held)
Entity extraction from judgments (parties, judges, statutes)
Saves research history and lets users re-run past queries
platforms.judgeApplicability: High — reasoning extraction, citation network graph, and search history persistence are directly useful. Entity extraction overlaps with our existing AI extraction.

platforms.name: Clio Manage (Clio Cloud)
keyFeatures: Court Rules calendaring — track court deadlines by jurisdiction & trigger event
Time tracking & billing (firm-oriented, N/A for judge)
platforms.judgeApplicability: Medium — Court Rules calendaring and customizable widgets translate well; time/billing is irrelevant. Bulk management is useful for case triage.

platforms.name: Relativity / RelativityOne
keyFeatures: AI-assisted review with automated coding suggestions
PII/PHI auto-detection and redaction at scale
platforms.judgeApplicability: High for evidence volume — clustering, dedup, and predictive coding would massively accelerate a judge's evidence triage in big cases.

platforms.name: Everlaw
keyFeatures: EverlawAI — automated coding suggestions, writing/review assistance, open-ended Q&A on documents
Storybuilder — narrative timeline construction from evidence
Native review with fast, intuitive UX
platforms.judgeApplicability: High — Storybuilder (narrative timeline) maps perfectly to our Timeline tab. Document-level Q&A on individual evidence files would be a game-changer for judge review.

platforms.name: Pre/Dicta (Judicial Prediction Intelligence)
keyFeatures: Predicts how a specific judge will rule (85% accuracy on motions to dismiss)
Trained on 15M federal cases with 50-100 data points per case
Litigation timeline forecasting by case stage
Judge behavioral patterns (grant/deny rates per motion type)
Resource allocation guidance ('should we invest in this case?')
platforms.judgeApplicability: Low for a judge's own self-use (they don't predict themselves) — but the SAME technique inverted could give the judge a 'how-similar-cases-resolved' comparator without issuing verdicts.

platforms.name: Saudi — Najiz Judicial Platform
keyFeatures: Four portals: individuals / businesses / lawyers / judges
Online case filing, e-payment of fees, virtual hearings
Single sign-on with national digital ID (Absher)
platforms.judgeApplicability: High for design reference — judge-specific portal separation + national-ID auth + real-time notifications + mobile-first are all directly applicable to an Egyptian judicial platform.

platforms.name: UAE — AI-Powered Integrated Judicial Platform (2025-2026)
keyFeatures: World's first fully integrated AI-powered judicial platform
AI analyzes case files & documents at multiple case stages
Cloud computing + secure inter-system data exchange
Smart court services — automated scheduling, e-filing, virtual hearings
Sharjah Judicial Council: digital file tracking + computerized movement index per file
platforms.judgeApplicability: Very High — UAE's judge-facing AI analysis at case stages is conceptually similar to our Sphinx Gateway. Digital file tracking + movement index is a judge's daily-bread feature we lack.

platforms.name: Egypt — Economic Courts ELEC (التقاضي الإلكتروني)
keyFeatures: Electronic filing of lawsuits, appeals, reconsideration
Online fee payment for civil cases (select primary courts, May 2026)
Digital Egypt (Misr Digital) national ID integration
Egyptian Justice City — integrated digital judicial system (under construction)
Online criminal records via Public Prosecution + Misr Digital
platforms.judgeApplicability: Critical for integration — our platform MUST interoperate with ELEC, esc.gov.eg, and Misr Digital national ID. This is the integration surface for a real Egyptian judicial platform.

platforms.name: Casefleet
keyFeatures: Fact chronology builder — tie facts to dates, witnesses, documents
Source-linked facts (every fact cites its evidence source)
Filterable timeline (by date, source, party, issue)
Issue-based fact coding (which facts bear on which legal issue)
Built-in search across all case materials
platforms.judgeApplicability: High — issue-based fact coding (linking each fact to the specific legal issue it bears on) is the missing link between our Facts tab and Issues tab.

platforms.name: Opus2 / DISCO Timelines
keyFeatures: Graphical timeline visualization with filter & zoom
Export timeline as image or PDF
platforms.judgeApplicability: High — our Timeline tab is vertical text-only. A graphical, filterable, multi-party swimlane view would let the judge 'see' the case shape at a glance.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Universal quick-search across all cases, legal texts, authorities, judge notes, deadlines — opens with one keystroke, fuzzy-matches, navigates directly to the entity. shadcn/ui `command` primitive is already installed but unused.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: Eliminates 4-6 clicks to find any case or authority; lets judge navigate at keyboard speed without leaving the current view
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: Wire to existing /api/cases, /api/corpus/search, /api/cases/[id]/notes, /api/deadlines. Add global keyboard listener (Ctrl+K). Reuse Command primitive.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Power-user shortcuts for the judge: J/K to navigate case list, Enter to open, E to edit, N for new, / to focus search, T to jump to tabs, G then D for dashboard, G then R for research center, B to bookmark current item, ? to show all shortcuts.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: Judges who type once and never touch the mouse will save hours per week
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: Single useHotkeys() hook with Mousetrap-style binding. Show '?' overlay. Store preferences in localStorage.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Per-legal-text bookmarks (anchor to a specific article/clause) with named markers (e.g., 'mention in verdict'), color-coded highlights, and a personal bookmarks panel. Currently judge-notes exists but is item-level only — needs character-level text anchoring on the legal text itself.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: Lets judge mark the exact paragraph in a statute or precedent they intend to cite — like dog-earing a printed code book
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: Add Bookmark model (legalTextId, anchorPath, label, color, judgeId). Render anchors on text view. Reuse existing JudgeNote table or fork a new TextBookmark table.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Pick 2-3 cases and view them side-by-side across Facts / Issues / Authorities / Indicators / Strength. Diff-style highlighting of what differs (similar facts, different defense coverage, opposing authority stance).
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: Judges routinely compare current case to precedent — visual side-by-side beats mental comparison
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: New route /api/cases/compare?ids=[a,b]. New CaseCompareView component. Leverages existing serialize layer. Could start with 2-case, expand to 3.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: PDF/document viewer with text highlight, sticky notes, anchored comments, freehand drawing (touch/stylus), and the ability to promote a highlighted passage directly into a Fact or Evidence entry. Currently Documents tab only shows metadata + extraction — no judge-level markup.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: Judges annotate paper case files today — same workflow must work digitally or they will print PDFs and lose the digital trail
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: Use react-pdf or pdf.js + custom annotation layer. Persist annotations per StoredDocument. 'Promote highlight → Fact' uses existing promote endpoint.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Visual calendar (month/week/day) with hearing dates pulled from case data, deadline engine, and external integration. Per-hearing prep checklist, automatic reminders (1-day, 1-hour). iCal/Google Calendar export.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: A judge's calendar IS the courtroom — deadlines engine exists but hearings don't. Critical for daily planning.
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: Add Hearing model (caseId, date, type, partiesPresent, prepStatus). Reuse existing calendar shadcn primitive. Wire to /api/cases/[id]/hearings.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Unified inbox of all judge-actionable items: deadline-approaching, contradiction-detected, adversary-review-pending-transfer, AI-extraction-needs-promotion, unverified-citation-found. Sorted by criticality. Each item has a 'snooze' and 'open case' action.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: Replaces the judge's mental todo list — single queue of 'what needs my decision today'
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: New /api/inbox route aggregating existing signals (deadlines, contradictions, adversary-review, documents pending promotion). Single right-rail or top-bar panel.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Chronological, filterable feed of what the judge themselves did (and what the system proposed) in the last N days — distinct from the audit log (which is technical/compliance-focused). Quick 'continue where you left off' entry points.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: When a judge returns to a case after a week, they need 'what did I last touch here?' — currently audit log is too technical
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: Reuse AuditLog with judge_decision source filter + simpler visual cards. Add to operations dashboard as a top widget.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Persist last 20 searches per judge (corpus + cases + authorities). Save a named search with filters as a 'watch' that re-runs on new corpus imports.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: Judges search the same statute over and over for different cases — saved searches eliminate retyping
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: Add SearchHistory table (judgeId, query, filters, timestamp). Add SavedSearch table for named watches. localStorage for offline tail.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: User-defined tags on Cases, Facts, Authorities, Evidence — multi-tag, colored, with tag management UI. Currently we use controlled vocab (stage/risk/operating-state) but no free-form judge tags like 'priority', 'follow-up', 'cited-in-verdict', 'needs-research'.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: Judges use post-its and margin notes today — tags are the digital equivalent
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: Add Tag model + Tagged polymorphic join. Bulk-tag actions in lists. Filter sidebar by tag combination.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Web Speech API (Arabic dialect support) for in-app voice-to-text on Judge Fields and Notes. Hands-free dictation during courtroom sessions or while reviewing documents. Auto-punctuation, custom legal vocabulary.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: Judges often dictate verdicts to a clerk today — same flow, but the judge keeps control of the text
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: Use Web Speech API (built into Chromium). ar-EG locale. Custom legal dictionary overlay. Mic button on every textarea.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Board view of cases by stage (e.g., intake → hearing → deliberation → verdict → archived) with drag-to-move. Quick visual caseload management. Alternative to current list view.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: Visual case triage on Monday morning — see the whole week's pipeline
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: Use @dnd-kit/core. Wire to PATCH /api/cases/[id] stage field. Toggle between list and board in sidebar.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: One-click export of: (a) Judge Fields (results/reasoning/draft) as a formatted PDF verdict; (b) case dossier as a Word document; (c) legal text with bookmarks as PDF; (d) timeline as image.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: Verdicts must be printable on official letterhead — and the case file must be exportable for archive
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: Server-side: pdfkit or @react-pdf/renderer. Word: docx library. Client-side export buttons in each tab.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Persistent FAB on mobile (bottom-right) and a top-bar split-button on desktop: 'New Case', 'New Deadline', 'New Note', 'Run Contrary Search', 'Capture Voice Note'. Single tap from anywhere.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Multi-select on Facts, Evidence, Authorities, Timeline events → bulk change status, bulk delete, bulk tag, bulk promote to verdict draft.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: When 50 facts are loaded from a long case file, judge needs to mark 'all proven' or 'all dismissed' in one action, not 50 clicks
criticalMissingFeatures.implementationNotes: Checkbox column on each list tab. Selection toolbar appears at top. Reuse existing PATCH endpoints.

criticalMissingFeatures.description: Drag-arrange widgets on Operations Dashboard: hide/show stat tiles, reorder, resize. Per-judge layout persisted.
criticalMissingFeatures.judgeBenefit: Different judges care about different metrics (some about deadlines, some about contradictions, some about pending promotions)

Micro-interactions — hover transitions, button press feedback, loading states with personality

summary: Our Egyptian Judicial Smart V2.1 platform is doctrinally ahead of every competitor studied: the strict AI/Judge separation, contrary-authority verification, signed corpus snapshots, and adversary review ('judicial shadow') are unique and judicially sound. However, the platform is currently optimized for DEPTH (analysis, doctrine, verification) and lacks VELOCITY features that competing platforms have standardized. The single most-impactful gap is the absence of a Command Palette (Cmd+K) — judges need keyboard-speed navigation, not menu navigation. Close behind: bookmark/highlight on legal texts (Lexis+ does this natively), document annotation (Relativity/Everlaw standard), graphical timeline with filters (Casefleet/Opus2), and a unified notifications/task inbox. The platform's existing infrastructure (Zod schemas, audit log, corpus search, AI extraction) makes most of these features medium-effort: they are UX layers over already-built data. Priority order for next sprint: (1) Command Palette + Keyboard Shortcuts [critical], (2) Bookmark/Highlight legal texts [critical], (3) Smart Notifications + Recent Activity Feed [high], (4) Hearing Calendar [high], (5) Export to PDF/Word [high], (6) Voice Dictation [high], (7) Document Annotation [high], (8) Case Comparison side-by-side [high], (9) Graphical Timeline with swimlanes [high], (10) Case Templates per court type [high]. Longer-term: Egyptian Government Integration Layer (ELEC + Misr Digital) is the unlock that turns this from a judge's personal tool into the national judicial operating system. The UAE AI-powered judicial platform (2025-2026) is the closest regional competitor and is moving fast — we should benchmark against it.
